observation_scope.claim: Chronological keyframe review and selected native detail review, not all-frame visual accuracy verification

observations.finding: Two wrist-mounted cameras: large rear screens, left-side black-white markers, top ID stickers, cables, neutral gray wall.
Wrists turn over; devices change from rear-facing to strong side/top views; mounts and cables move with wrists.
Manipulating denim jacket on grid cloth. Cameras mostly lower/inner wrist, smaller than opening view; side details and partial rear-screen visibility.
Cameras converge above dark clothing; projected bodies and mounts nearly touch, with varying tilt and partial obscuration.
Fastening front buttons and raising garment. Own forearm/mount can hide a substantial part of one camera (frame 1980); cloth proximity does not establish pervasive cloth occlusion.
Folding sleeves/body changes background and hand pose. Cloth edges pass between hands; sampled camera bodies are often still visible.
Wrists rise against wall; large side/front oblique cameras, right camera truncated by bottom frame edge at frame 2849.

mount_forearm.placement: Attach camera to wrist rig; occlude at attachment-facing side and its changing projected edge; depth order determined in 3D.

cable.placement: Start at the camera connector and bend alongside/across forearm; preserve small cable thickness; no arbitrary full-screen stripe.

other_camera.placement: Bring both wrists toward center with feasible separation; preserve depth order and distinguish two instances.

fabric.placement: Use actual grasped/folded cloth edge outside camera, entering silhouette only if depth supports it; avoid blanket coverage.

negative_distractors.placement: Wrist strap, round light gray wrist module, black mount, connector, grid lines, denim buttons and dark clothes, with no Action4 body.

proposed_s0.note: These are training-design weights, not empirical video frequencies or fitted 6D pose measurements.

rotation.method: Sample around evidence-matched 3D anchor poses; move wrist and device as a rigid assembly.
